verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents a personalized dashboard that serves as a central hub for updates and documents. Received registered-agent mail is scanned into secure cloud storage with alerts, and compliance status and license tracking are also handled through the account. This covers the received-documents and state-registration parts of the story for a single business. Missing for 10: evidence that multiple entities can be managed from one account, team/multi-user access with roles (sharing business licenses is not the same as shared account access), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
